[1/3] Require per-hunk attestations (verbatim quote plus unique note) for a Reforge review, cap the answer file, and record host versus analyzer provenance

impact_assessment.why: A review answer that listed every hunk id but quoted nothing was accepted as fully reviewed. The coverage gate only compared ids, so an operator or agent could mark a 777-hunk packet reviewed without reading a single hunk; that is exactly what happened on Merklock.
impact_assessment.benefits: A review counts only when every hunk carries an exact added (or, for a deletion, removed) line and a distinct note; an id-only or bulk-generated list is recorded partial; provenance shows whether an analyzer or the host produced the review.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the reviewed_hunks schema changes from a string list to objects, and old answers become partial; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none, the review write stays inside the existing run lock; state: review metadata gains method and attestation fields, existing run history stays readable
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit and integration tests for id-only, wrong-quote, duplicate-note and valid answers; a size-capped answer reader; prompt, CLI help, skill and ADR updates; both test tiers and every read-only gate before the milestone commit

impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin every repository to a 40-character SHA, read at least four source files per dossier, verify every cited path and line with audit-claims, reserve exactly two ids per review, run validate and render --check before closing
